title: 6 Days Ndutu Safari | Experience the calving Great migration
description: Experience the unforgettable 6 Days Ndutu Safari, one of the best Tanzania safari packages for witnessing the spectacular Great Wildebeest Migration Calving Season. From January to March, the Ndutu Plains in the southern Serengeti ecosystem become the nursery of the migration, where hundreds of thousands of wildebeest gather to give birth. This remarkable wildlife event attracts lions, cheetahs, leopards, hyenas, jackals, and other predators, creating one of Africa’s greatest natural spectacles. A Ndutu Safari during this period offers unmatched opportunities to witness dramatic wildlife interactions and experience one of Africa’s most iconic natural events.

This Ndutu Safari combines extended game drives in the famous Ndutu Conservation Area with a visit to the breathtaking Ngorongoro Crater, a UNESCO World Heritage Site renowned for its exceptional wildlife density and Big Five sightings. Perfect for wildlife enthusiasts, photographers, couples, families, and nature lovers, this Ndutu Safari offers unforgettable encounters, spectacular landscapes, and world-class game viewing. Whether it is your first safari or a return visit to Tanzania, a Ndutu Safari promises an extraordinary adventure filled with unforgettable wildlife experiences.
Price may vary depending on travel dates, accommodation category, and group size.

itinerary.title: Arrival in Arusha
itinerary.text: Upon arrival at Kilimanjaro International Airport (JRO) or Arusha Airport, you will be met by your professional safari guide from Glad of Africa Safari & Tours. After a short safari briefing, transfer to your hotel in Arusha to relax before starting your 6 Days Ndutu Calving Season Safari. Enjoy the warm hospitality of Tanzania and prepare for an unforgettable Great Wildebeest Migration Safari.

itinerary.title: Arusha to Ndutu Area
itinerary.text: After an early breakfast, depart for the famous Ndutu Conservation Area, located in the southern Serengeti ecosystem. Arrive in time for an afternoon game drive across the wildlife-rich Ndutu Plains, where hundreds of thousands of wildebeest, zebras, and gazelles gather during the Great Wildebeest Migration Calving Season. Look out for lions, cheetahs, leopards, and hyenas that closely follow the migrating herds.

itinerary.title: Full-Day Ndutu Area
itinerary.text: Spend the entire day exploring the spectacular Ndutu Plains, one of the best places in Africa to witness the Great Wildebeest Migration. During the calving season, thousands of wildebeest calves are born every day, creating incredible wildlife encounters. Enjoy excellent opportunities to photograph predators, large herds of wildebeest, zebras, giraffes, elephants, and a variety of birdlife on this unforgettable Ndutu Safari

itinerary.title: Full-Day Ndutu Area, Explore Newborn Wildebeest and Predators
itinerary.text: Enjoy another exciting day in the Ndutu Conservation Area, following the massive migration herds across the endless plains. Watch newborn wildebeest calves take their first steps while lions, cheetahs, leopards, hyenas, and jackals patrol the area in search of prey. This is the perfect day for wildlife photography and experiencing one of nature's greatest spectacles during the Ndutu Calving Season Safari.

itinerary.title: Morning Game Drive in Ndutu – Transfer to Ngorongoro Crater Rim
itinerary.text: After breakfast, enjoy a final half-day game drive in the Ndutu Plains, giving you one last opportunity to witness the incredible Great Wildebeest Migration and its abundant predators. In the afternoon, drive to the scenic Ngorongoro Crater Rim, where you will enjoy breathtaking views over the world's largest intact volcanic caldera and prepare for the next day's Big Five Safari.

itinerary.title: Ngorongoro Crater Safari – Departure
itinerary.text: After an early breakfast, descend into the spectacular Ngorongoro Crater for a memorable game drive. This UNESCO World Heritage Site is one of the best places in Tanzania to see the Big Five, including the endangered black rhino, lions, elephants, buffaloes, and leopards. After a picnic lunch on the crater floor, drive back to Arusha before your transfer to Kilimanjaro International Airport (JRO) for your departure flight, bringing your unforgettable Ndutu Calving Season Safari to a close
